statements.t: Preliminary third quarter revenue and Adjusted EBITDA above the Company’s outlook 1 ; full third quarter results and conference call scheduled for November 10 and 11, 2026, respectively
• Revenue of approximately $461.5 million, up approximately 49% year-over-year and above the Company’s outlook of $440.0 million
• Adjusted EBITDA 3 of approximately $64.5 million, up approximately 64% year-over-year and above the Company’s outlook of $63.0 million

“We are sharing these preliminary results to provide investors with timely visibility into the quarter, and we look forward to discussing our full third quarter results in more detail on November 11,” said Andy Parrott, Chief Executive Officer of ITG.
Complete third quarter results will be included in the Company’s third quarter earnings release and its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q.
